name: @equin/plugin-integrations-cloudflare
description: Stateless Cloudflare API client: listZones(token) (the zones a token can read), zoneOfHostname(zones, hostname) (the zone a hostname belongs to) and purgeCacheTags(token, zone, tags) (drop what the edge cached under a Cache-Tag), every answer's v4 envelope zod-parsed and a refusal thrown in Cloudflare's own words. Takes the token per call.
